TC-001: Verify planned outage window is exactly 10 minutes on 2nd Sunday
  Steps:
    - On the 2nd Sunday, monitor system downtime duration.
    - Confirm downtime duration equals 10 minutes.

TC-002: Verify planned outage window does not exceed 10 minutes on 2nd Sunday
  Steps:
    - On the 2nd Sunday, monitor system downtime duration.
    - Confirm downtime duration is ≤ 10 minutes.

TC-003: Verify planned outage window does not occur on non-2nd Sunday
  Steps:
    - On a non-2nd Sunday (e.g., 1st Sunday), monitor system availability.
    - Confirm system is available (no downtime).

TC-004: Verify full backup taken every night
  Steps:
    - Check backup logs for two consecutive days.
    - Confirm a full backup was taken each day.

TC-005: Verify backup cycle: oldest backup removed after 30 days
  Steps:
    - Wait for 31 days from the first backup.
    - Check backup storage for the oldest backup.
    - Confirm oldest backup is no longer present.

TC-006: Verify rollback to exactly 30 days ago is successful
  Steps:
    - Attempt to rollback to a point 30 days ago.
    - Confirm rollback completes successfully.

TC-007: Verify rollback to 31 days ago fails
  Steps:
    - Attempt to rollback to a point 31 days ago.
    - Confirm rollback fails with appropriate error.

TC-008: Verify backup restored on dummy production system after each backup
  Steps:
    - After a backup is taken, check dummy production system.
    - Confirm backup was restored successfully.

TC-009: Verify dummy production database purged after restoration
  Steps:
    - After restoration, check dummy production database.
    - Confirm database is empty (reset to initial state).

TC-010: Verify backup storage location configured as Mangalore HQ
  Steps:
    - Check system configuration for backup storage location.
    - Confirm location is "Mangalore HQ".

TC-011: Verify system compliance setting enabled for Government of India regulations
  Steps:
    - Check system configuration for compliance setting.
    - Confirm setting is enabled.
